data.name: Althaf
data.gender_notes: Althaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Althaf is derived from the Arabic word 'thafa' which means 'to protect' or 'to shelter'. It is a name of comfort and security, evoking the image of a fortified fortress or a loving guardian. In Islamic context, it is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions who sought his protection and guidance, and were granted safety and enlightenment in return.
data.etymology: Althaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protection, Shelter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Althaf total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
